guidetextdraw_1796710448._value:
• For incidents involving theft or vandalism with on-campus property, an incident report must be filed with campus UPD Office: (657) 278 - 4308.
  • For incidents with off-campus property, the local police department shall be notified and a police report filed for the stolen and/or vandalized property.
  • In all cases of theft or loss of information assets or equipment containing Level 1 (Confidential) or  Level 2 (Internal Use) information, the CSUF IT Security Department must be notified immediately upon discovery.
  • Retain a copy of UPD Report and Lost or Stolen Property Form.
